outputSamples.text: The real shift is when teams stop configuring a tool manually after week one. If it only makes demos cleaner, it stays optional. Test one real workflow first: speed, rollback, and default behavior. If only the demo improves, wait.

outputSamples.title: Under packets about debugging AI agents or LLM observability tools.
outputSamples.angle: Prediction: observability becomes core for agent teams.
outputSamples.text: Next quarter, the teams that treat observability as a core feature, not a packet-mortem afterthought, will ship agents faster. Start tracing before the first outage, not after.

outputSamples.title: Under packets about platform changes in GitHub, OpenAI, or other big tech defaults.
outputSamples.angle: Prediction: defaults shift, causing distribution tax.
outputSamples.text: The next shift is boring but brutal: this moves from feature to default, then everyone else pays the distribution tax. If a platform changes defaults, your workflow changes, whether you like it or not.

outputSamples.title: Under packets comparing AI model benchmarks or showcasing new model capabilities.
outputSamples.angle: Decision rule: test real workflow, not demos.
outputSamples.text: Don't migrate to a new AI model because the demo looks better. Test one real workflow: speed, rollback, and default behavior. If only the demo improves, wait. The demo is not the workflow.
